sources.title: CSCEC confirms China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2.1 topping-out
sources.summary: Contractor confirms Phase 2.1 shell is topped out. Includes data center, support machine room and 220kV substation. No operation is stated; exact milestone day is unspecified.
sources.date_semantics: September 14 is current-state confirmation publication date, not the unspecified recent topping-out day.

sources.title: CSCEC Fifth Bureau confirms Baozhiyun Huabei A4/A5 MEP acceptance
sources.summary: Contractor confirms A4 and A5 MEP works passed completion acceptance. Campus quantities cover six data-center buildings and are not phase capacity. No operational assertion is made.
sources.date_semantics: September 2 is current-state confirmation publication date, not the unspecified recent acceptance day.

sources.title: CABR Technology identifies Baozhiyun Huabei inside Xuanhua Steel plant
sources.summary: Project designer identifies the Baozhiyun Huabei campus within Xuanhua Steel plant, Xuanhua District, Zhangjiakou. No numeric point or phase-specific boundary is provided.
sources.date_semantics: Page body says August 29, 2025 despite October in the path. Used only for identity and parent property, not current status.
